title: Call Log & Dialer
notes: Call Log and Transcript Search rebuilt on ListPage (FilterBar via a direction/status dropdown, infinite scroll, hover row actions, skeleton, bulk delete, full-dataset CSV export). Call detail rebuilt on DetailPage with Overview/Related tabs, SendMessageDialog messaging when a contact is linked, and wired end/transfer actions (voipApi.calls.end/transfer, previously orphaned). Dial pad rebuilt with PhoneInput and a RelationCombobox contact picker. Analytics rebuilt with token-based StatCards and a DataTable for top callers. All five pages gate on voip_calling via useFeatureGate and render an upgrade/disabled state instead of calling the API when off. No detail drawer (call detail is a full page, matching prior nav) and no AddressAutocomplete/CurrencyInput/DatePicker — none of the call fields are address, money, or date-only. Missed-call mark-returned (voipApi.missedCalls.markReturned) and transcript update are wired into voip.ts but have no dedicated missed-calls page in this slice's page list; call it out if a future slice needs one.
showcaseScript: Open the Call Log and filter to missed calls
Place an outbound call from the dialer
Open a call recording and read its transcript
